event.title: Ferry Capsizes in Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba, Resulting in Multiple Fatalities and Missing Persons
event.canonical_title: Ferry Capsizes in Zimbabwe's Lake Kariba, Resulting in Multiple Fatalities and Missing Persons
event.summary: A ferry capsized on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe, leading to at least 15 confirmed deaths and 27 individuals reported missing. Search and rescue operations are ongoing, with 77 people successfully rescued and taken to a nearby island. Authorities are coordinating efforts to bring the survivors back to safety.

timeline.title: Death Toll in Zimbabwe Ferry Capsizing Reaches 72
timeline.summary: The death toll from the ferry capsizing on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe has risen to 72, according to police reports. Authorities have recovered 25 bodies as the search for additional victims continues following the tragic incident earlier this week.

timeline.title: Death Toll from Zimbabwe Boat Capsizing Rises to 80
timeline.summary: The death toll from a ferry capsizing on Lake Kariba, Zimbabwe, has risen to 80, with more bodies recovered. The incident occurred earlier this week, and investigations indicate that the ferry was overloaded during heavy winds. Among the deceased are eighteen children.
